Get committee memberships

Source: R/query-tables.R
get_committee_members.Rd

Reads the committee_members table, or the v_committee_members_display view with display = TRUE: one row per committee membership. Committee roles and dates.

Usage

get_committee_members(
  PHID = NULL,
  committee_type = NULL,
  committee_area = NULL,
  start_date = NULL,
  end_date = NULL,
  end_date_status = NULL,
  committee_member_id = NULL,
  ...,
  active_during = NULL,
  display = FALSE,
  columns = NULL,
  collect = TRUE,
  limit = NULL
)

Arguments

PHID

Filter on column PHID (VARCHAR).

committee_type

Filter on column committee_type (VARCHAR).

committee_area

Filter on column committee_area (VARCHAR).

start_date

Filter on column start_date (DATE).

end_date

Filter on column end_date (DATE).

end_date_status

Filter on column end_date_status (VARCHAR).

committee_member_id

Filter on column committee_member_id (VARCHAR).

...

Must be empty. It forces the arguments after it to be named.

active_during

Keep rows whose period overlaps this: a year, a date (Date or "YYYY-MM-DD"), or an in_range() of years or dates. The period runs from start_date to end_date; a missing end_date means it is ongoing. NULL (the default) applies no date filter.

display

If TRUE, read the v_committee_members_display view, which adds display columns to the table's own. Filters still apply.

columns

Character vector of columns to return; NULL returns all.

collect

If TRUE (the default), return a tibble; if FALSE, a lazy table for further dplyr work.

limit

Maximum number of rows to return, or NULL for no limit.

Value

A tibble with one row per committee membership and every column of committee_members (or of v_committee_members_display) (zero rows if nothing matches), or a lazy table if collect = FALSE.

Details

Every column except content and *_raw columns is a filter argument, spelt as in the database. Each takes NULL (no filter, the default), a vector of values to match, in_range() for an inclusive range, or matches_pattern() for a case-insensitive pattern. Filters combine with AND. Stored values are returned unchanged, and no other filter is applied.

Generated from the database catalog by data-raw/generate-getters.R; for tables without a getter use db_tbl().

See also

in_range(), matches_pattern(), db_tbl()

Examples

db_connect(sample = TRUE)
get_committee_members(committee_area = matches_pattern("%legislation%"), active_during = 2001)
